{{Quote|The mountain is under attack, sir. Two different forces of natives, plus some Rebel saboteurs. And a group of Noghri&hellip;|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] just before Thrawn's [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|death]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
The '''Assault on Mount Tantiss''', also known as the '''battle of Mount Tantiss''', was carried out by agents of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to shut down [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facility at [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The Emperor had a private storehouse. It was beneath a mountain on a world he called Wayland. One of the artificial caverns held a complete cloning facility.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
[[File:MountTantiss.png|thumb|left|150px|[[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]].]]

During the [[Thrawn campaign]], former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] was arrested by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] for a possible implication in an [[Raid on Coruscant (Thrawn Crisis)|Imperial raid]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. She later revealed to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] that she knew the location of [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facility. Skywalker agreed to liberate her in exchange for the coordinates of [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]].<ref name="TLC" />

Meanwhile [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Kleyn Selid]] had discovered that [[Joruus C'baoth]] had killed [[General/Legends|General]] [[Freja Covell]] in manipulating his mind. Selid reported to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] Thrawn, who ordered C'baoth to be put under arrest and confined in the [[Emperor's throne room]]. But, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] had the time to send Covell's forces to kill the [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamiri]] placed by Thrawn near Mount Tantiss to control C'baoth.<ref name="TLC" />

On Coruscant, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] met the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Talon Karrde]]. He revealed to her that the Empire took a large amount of ysalamiri on [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] and that it could be a trap for Skywalker. They decided to go to Wayland together to warn their friends.<ref name="TLC" />

==The Mission==
===In the forest===
{{Quote|I am Ekhrikhor clan Bakh'tor. I greet you, son of Vader.|[[Ekhrikhor]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
[[File:Ekhrikhor2-TLC5.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Ekhrikhor]] introduces [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to the [[Psadan]]s and [[Myneyrsh]]i.]]

[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Luke Skywalker, along with Mara Jade, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] landed on Wayland and trekked through the forests of Wayland to Mount Tantiss.

They first met a group of [[Noghri Death Commando]]s who came to Wayland to help the son of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. They later met some inhabitants of the planet, the [[Myneyrsh]]i and the [[Psadan]]s, and convinced them to stay neutral. Some Myneyrshi eventually decided to help them in fighting the Empire.<ref name="TLC" />

===Destroy Mount Tantiss===
[[File:Mara_Fighting_Stormies.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] fighting alongside Skywalker.]]
They eventually entered the Mount Tantiss facility when they fought [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Calrissian and Chewbacca went off to find a way to destroy the facility while Skywalker and Jade went to look for the facility's remote destruct control. In the cloning chambers, Calrissian was eventually able to rig an [[arhythmic resonance scheme]] to destroy Mount Tantiss. Meanwhile Skywalker's sister, Leia Organa Solo, entered the facility with Talon Karrde.<ref name="TLC" />

===Duel in the throne room===
{{Quote|So at last you have come to me. I knew you would. Together we will teach the galaxy what it means to serve the Jedi.|[[Joruus C'baoth]] to [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="TLC" />}}
[[File:LukeVersusluuke.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Luke Skywalker duels his [[Luuke Skywalker|clone]].]]
Skywalker and Jade entered the throne room and confronted the mad [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] clone Joruus C'baoth. C'baoth killed [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]-dampening [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamiri]] and revealed [[Luuke Skywalker]], a clone of Skywalker. Skywalker and the clone [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|faced off]] as C'baoth incapacitated Jade with a blast of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].<ref name="TLC" />

Eventually, Leia Organa Solo, Han Solo, and Talon Karrde entered the throne room. C'baoth unleashed a [[Force scream/Legends|Force scream]], stunning everyone in the room. Taking advantage of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master's]] distraction, Jade managed to Force pull Organa Solo's lightsaber, and slew Skywalker's clone, carrying out the Emperor's last command. Enraged for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Skywalker's clone, the Jedi Master began to bring the ceiling down on Jade and Skywalker.

[[File:Maracbaoth.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Mara Jade kills [[Joruus C'baoth|C'baoth]].]]
However, Jade used Organa Solo's lightsaber to cut holes in the floor so that the rocks fell through and moved against C'baoth. Guided mentally by Organa Solo, she reached the insane Jedi and cut him down with the lightsaber. He exploded in a [[Dark side burst|blast of dark side energy]].<ref name="TLC" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Thrawn's dead, his cloning center is a shambles, and the Empire's in retreat again. You've won.''"<br />"''We won at Endor, too. That didn't stop us from years of so-called mopping-up action. There's still a lot of work yet to be done.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
The destruction of the Mount Tantiss facility halted the Imperial cloning operation once and for all. With the death of Thrawn at the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]], the events of the day were disastrous for the Empire and ended the Thrawn campaign.<ref name="TLC" />

Skywalker's duel with his clone went on to traumatize him for the days following.<ref name="Mirror">{{WEGCite|story=Mirror Image|book=The Last Command Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>

After the destruction of Mount Tantiss, Wayland became a planet of particular interest to the New Republic. Researchers and [[New Republic Intelligence Service|Intelligence]] officers scoured the planet and ruins for clues to aid in their defeat of Imperial warlords, discovering evidence that would lead to the political fallout of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] involvement in the destruction of [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]]. The New Republic also relocated the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] to the colony of [[New Nystao]] on Wayland to escape their collapsing home world of [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]].
